variants.prompt: The alluring Southern belle steps out of a sparkling ocean onto a moonlit yacht deck, champagne silk gown hiked up to reveal creamy thighs and a scandalously short hemline. Her raven tresses whip in the sea breeze as she turns to face the camera, emerald eyes sparkling with mischief and invitation. Statement jewelry glimmers against her porcelain skin, and a feathered fan fans the flames of her sultry allure.
